$schema-doc: Each entry surfaces as a card at /planned-website. Drop the HTML into public/plan/, then add an entry here. The route auto-renders.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Mockup v1
projects.description: First-pass mockup for a family architecture studio in Bali. Hero-led layout with tropical-wisdom framing — anchors the brand voice before later iterations refine it.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Mockup v2 (Minimalism)
projects.description: Stripped-down version of the studio site. Pares the chrome back to typography and a single accent — testing whether the studio voice survives without ornament.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Mockup v3 (Editorial)
projects.description: Studio-journal direction: editorial layout that frames the practice as ongoing notes, not a marketing site. Designed to age well as the studio publishes more work.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Home (Photographic)
projects.description: Multi-page split: dedicated homepage that leads with photography. Climate, soil, family — the framing the studio listens to before designing.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Studio (Long Document)
projects.description: Companion to the photographic home: the about page as a long-form document. Who we are, how we work, why we choose slow.

projects.title: Akusara Samitra — Projects (Bento Grid)
projects.description: Project index using a bento-grid layout: each completed house gets its own tile sized by significance. Climate, soil, family — every house different.
